info.name: 你好呀，我的橘子恋人
info.plot: As the chairman of a successful technology company, Lu Kun often finds himself in large group settings. While he has no problem addressing any number of people, he has incredible difficulty with any sort of direct, physical contact. Suffering from a strange allergy which is only triggered by direct skin-to-skin contact, something as simple as a handshake could prove deadly. Without the ability to directly come into contact with others, Lu Kun is intrigued when he learns a doctor by the name of Fu Yang has created an incredibly lifelike robot companion dubbed Friday.

translations.title: 你好呀，我的橘子恋人
translations.overview: 顶尖智能科技公司总裁陆森（梁靖康饰）患有肢体接触障碍，因此只能独自生活在远离人群的庄园中，而他和父母一起种下的橘子树，是他唯一的情感寄托。而热爱发明的杨善善（孙千饰）在机缘巧合下，不得不假扮成机器人星期五，与陆森一同生活，从一开始的乌龙不断到真心陪伴，两人在朝夕相处与斗智斗勇中，逐渐打开心扉，探寻人与人之间的联系与信任，此后两人便陷入了如橘子般酸甜绚烂的爱情中，最终收获了爱与成长 。
